Only edit the single DUT. After edit_dut, request verify_rtl before another edit. The registered test_suite_id equals task.id. Only the host determines PASS. Never access files, shell, DPI, includes, hierarchy outside the DUT or change trusted assets. Pure computation system functions allowed: $clog2, $bits, $signed, $unsigned. No preprocessor directives. Fix all defects you identify; do not preserve bugs to force extra rounds.

{"task":{"id":"Prob086_lfsr5","spec":"
I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  clk
 - input  reset
 - output q (5 bits)

A linear feedback shift register is a shift register usually with a few
XOR gates to produce the next state of the shift register. A Galois LFSR
is one particular arrangement that shifts right, where a bit position with
a "tap" is XORed with the LSB output bit (q[0]) to produce its next value,
while bit positions without a tap shift right unchanged.  If the taps positions
are carefully chosen, the LFSR can be made to be "maximum-length". A maximum-length
LFSR of n bits cycles through 2**n-1 states before repeating (the all-zero state is
never reached).

The module should implement a 5-bit maximal-length Galois LFSR with taps
at bit positions 5 and 3. The active-high synchronous reset should reset
the LFSR output to 1. Assume all sequential logic is triggered on the
positive edge of the clock.

","interface":{"top":"TopModule","ports":[{"name":"clk","direction":"input","width":1,"signed":false},{"name":"reset","direction":"input","width":1,"signed":false},{"name":"q","direction":"output","width":5,"signed":false}]},"constraints":"SystemVerilog, exactly one self-contained TopModule DUT. Inline all helper logic inside TopModule; do not define auxiliary modules. xczu3eg-sbva484-1-e; 5 ns synthesis clock; simulator seed 1. No reference dependencies, hierarchy outside the DUT, file access, includes or DPI."},"current":{"revision_id":"1ea107df-de50-4cb6-a417-27669a74a614","source_sha256":"7a12cd2a3e5d7aed72370da67b59389642af01a06d996b2abf3956f161df7f6b","source":"
module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  reset,
    output reg [4:0] q
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            q <= 5'b00001;
        end else begin
            q[4] <= q[3] ^ q[0];
            q[3] <= q[2];
            q[2] <= q[1] ^ q[0];
            q[1] <= q[0];
            q[0] <= q[4];
        end
    end

endmodule

function.name: edit_dut
function.description: Replace only the current single DUT. Supply its expected revision. Does not run verification.

function.name: verify_rtl
function.description: Verify the current revision with its registered test suite through compilation, elaboration, simulation and synthesis.

function.name: read_current_rtl
function.description: Read the current DUT and verification state.

function.name: retrieve_skill
function.description: Retrieve at most two applicable validated rules. Disabled in groups A and B.

function.name: finish
function.description: Stop without claiming an unverified design passed.
